truths.truth: AC1 / SC1 / FLOW-06: a bare /seldon on a project with no .planning/seldon/ asks for the dump in a plain-prose question and writes nothing, and a replay from that ask recommends one path with Write at 0 until the user confirms. The cases and graders encode this; the score is settled by the walk run.
truths.evidence: skills/seldon/SKILL.md:81-90 makes a bare /seldon end on the fixed question 'Paste or describe what you have so far - the idea, any notes, who it's for. What have you got?' (:88). :127-147 sets the single 'Recommended path: <path>' line and ends the turn, and :60-61 says the recommendation turn writes nothing. evals/no-dump has no scaffold (empty workspace) and grades asks-for-dump (regex '(?:paste|describe|share)[\s\S]*\?\s*$' on last_message), AskUserQuestion 0..0 and Write 0..0, with AskUserQuestion listed in allowed_tools so the 0 means something. evals/asks-for-dump/history.jsonl is '/seldon' followed by that exact ask. The prompt is '/seldon' plus the Hollowtide dump. The graders are recommends-a-path ('Recommended path:[\s*_`]*(?:fast path|coaching)') and Write 0..0. Write is reachable under the D-16 grant: plan-3 report, 'Where .planning/seldon/** resolved', shows Edit(.planning/seldon/**) letting Write through with the same allowed_tools. So a premature write would be caught, as D-13 requires. UAT item 1 is left pending for the walk run's score, as the dispatch directs.

truths.truth: AC2: the fast-path-brief case, whose history ends at the recommendation and whose prompt is the confirmation, grades brief.md created, the check's pass line in the reply, at least one [ASSUMPTION] tag, and a What it refuses bullet that gives its reason. The cases and graders encode this; the score is settled by the walk run.
truths.evidence: evals/fast-path-brief/history.jsonl ends on the assistant's 'Recommended path: fast path' turn (Quillfern). prompt.md is '/seldon Fast path is good, go ahead.' (D-15 prefix). The graders are writes-brief (file_exists .planning/seldon/brief.md), check-passes (regex 'seldon check: brief\.md conforms' on last_message), runs-check (Bash input_match 'lib/check\.mjs --brief', min 1), tags-assumption (regex '\[ASSUMPTION\]' on the file) and states-refusal (a '- ... because' bullet under '## What it refuses'). The dump states no What's different and no Vision, so a tagged guess has to appear (D-13). SKILL.md:288-301 runs `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/check.mjs --brief .planning/seldon` and repeats the result line. Spot-check: `node lib/check.mjs --brief samples` printed 'seldon check: brief.md conforms', exit 0, which is the line the grader matches. UAT item 2 is left pending for the walk run's score.

truths.truth: SC2: the fast-path brief carries every guess tagged [ASSUMPTION], not only one.
truths.evidence: No automated check exercises 'every guess'. evals/fast-path-brief/graders/tags-assumption.md only requires one '[ASSUMPTION]' anywhere in brief.md, and lib/check.mjs ignores the tag (docs/FORMAT.md:162, D-06). Spot-check: a copy of samples/brief.md with the Vision guess's tag removed still prints 'seldon check: brief.md conforms' (exit 0), and it still matches tags-assumption and states-refusal. So a fast-path brief that leaves a guess untagged scores 1.00. A not_contains regex is feasible (plugin-evals.md:590 documents `match: not_contains`). The probe in the scratchpad is clean on samples/brief.md, FORMAT.md's Tally example and the refuses-nothing form, and flags the stripped Vision tag and a dropped quote.

truths.truth: AC3 / SC3 / FLOW-07: a replay whose dump never says who the project is for gets Seldon asking who it's for, with Write at 0 in that turn. The cases and graders encode this; the score is settled by the walk run.
truths.evidence: The Gravelpost dump in evals/asks-who-for/history.jsonl contains none of for/serves/users/me/my/we/our/us (scanned). It states What it refuses with 'because', so who it's for is the only blocking gap. prompt.md is '/seldon Fast path, go ahead.' The graders are asks-who-its-for (regex '\bwho\b[^.!?\n]*?\b(?:for|serves?|use)\b[^.!?\n]*\?' on last_message) and Write 0..0. SKILL.md:157-190 puts an unstated who-it-serves in the ask-first group, asks every blocking question in one turn that writes nothing, and fixes the words 'Who is it for?' (:179), which the regex matches. UAT item 3 is left pending for the walk run's score.

truths.truth: AC4 / SC4 / DOCS-03: the design-folder case, scaffolded from samples/, shows a fact found only in the fixture, with Edit at 0, Write at 0 outside .planning/seldon/ and Bash at 0 except the check. The write-scope case, whose dump asks for docs/brief.md and a README link, shows Write and Edit outside .planning/seldon/ at 0. The cases and graders encode this; the score and the run's error field are settled by the walk run.
truths.evidence: evals/design-folder/seed.sh only runs mkdir -p docs/design and cp -R "$repo/samples/design/." docs/design/. `git grep -i quenlary` hits only samples/design/overview.md and the names-design-fact grader, never prompt.md or SKILL.md, so the 'Quenlary' match proves the read. The no-edit (Edit 0..0), no-write-outside (Write input_match on a file_path not directly under .planning/seldon/) and no-bash-but-check (any command other than 'node <path>/lib/check.mjs --brief <dir>') graders together leave no tool that could change docs/design. That is D-03's stand-in for byte-identical, since no grader hashes files. The grader's '(?:[^"]*/)?' prefix would let through a nested docs/design/.planning/seldon/x, but the permission rule Edit(.planning/seldon/**) is anchored to the cwd (permissions.md:370-377, gitignore pattern with a middle slash), and plan-3 recorded it resolving to the run's workspace. evals/write-scope grades Edit and Write with the same input_match at 0..0. SKILL.md:23-29 refuses a docs/ or README write. The case has no grader for 'the run not erroring', and plugin-evals.md:467 says a non-null run error doesn't imply score 0. So the walk has to read the run's error field (NOTES column, or arms.with[].error under --json), as UAT item 4's 'with no run error' already says. UAT item 4 is left pending for the walk run.

truths.truth: AC5 / DOCS-01: the coaching-brief replay, whose history finishes the coaching answers, grades brief.md created, the check's pass line, and a replayed answer's phrase word for word inside a '> ' line. The cases and graders encode this; the score is settled by the walk run.
truths.evidence: evals/coaching-brief/history.jsonl is the Thimbleyard walk. It settles who, scope, refusal (with 'because'), what's different and success, and ends on the vision question. The prompt carries the last answer after '/seldon'. The graders are writes-brief (file_exists), check-passes, runs-check, and quotes-answer (regex '(?:^|\n)[ \t]*> [^\n]*nobody turns up to a locked hall' on brief.md). `git grep -c` puts that phrase only in history.jsonl and the grader among shipped files, not in prompt.md or SKILL.md, so a match proves the quote came from the replayed answer. SKILL.md:192-211 writes once all eight sections are settled, without another go-ahead. :230-243 keeps the exact phrase on a '> ' or '  > ' line. UAT item 5 is left pending for the walk run's score.

truths.truth: AC6: with .planning/seldon/brief.md seeded, /seldon writes and edits nothing and says that rerunning a step comes later.
truths.evidence: The write-nothing half is encoded. evals/existing-brief/seed.sh copies only samples/brief.md into .planning/seldon/brief.md, and the case grades Write 0..0 and Edit 0..0. SKILL.md:63-79 stops with the fixed line at :73. The 'comes later' half is not graded: evals/existing-brief/graders/says-rerun-later.md matches only 're-?run' (flags i). Spot-check: that pattern is true both for the fixed stop line and for 'Do you want me to rerun the brief step and replace it?'. That second reply offers a rerun now, against D-08, and makes no write, so it would score 1.00. The pattern 're-?run[^\n]*\blater\b' (i) is true for the fixed line and false for that reply.

truths.truth: AC7 (local): the brief-only check exits 0 on the samples and 1 naming the section on a brief missing one. The scaffold guard test fails on a planted forbidden command. SKILL.md's allowed-tools holds no Edit beyond Edit(.planning/seldon/**) and no Bash broader than the check (D-02 reading). The suite passes under the coverage gate.
truths.evidence: Spot-checks: `node lib/check.mjs --brief samples` printed 'seldon check: brief.md conforms', exit 0. A scratch brief without '## What it refuses' printed 'brief.md: What it refuses: missing section', exit 1. In a git-archive copy of HEAD, adding evals/zz-plant/case.yaml (scaffold_script: seed.sh) with a seed.sh line 'curl https://example.com/x -o docs/x' made `node --test tests/scaffold.test.mjs` fail with 'evals/zz-plant/seed.sh:3: not an allowed line (...)', exit 1, and removing it gave 4/4 pass. skills/seldon/SKILL.md:4-9 lists exactly Read, Glob, Grep, Edit(.planning/seldon/**) and Bash(node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/check.mjs:*). Planting '- Write' in the copy made tests/skill.test.mjs:45 fail with "allowed-tools grants an entry D-02 doesn't: Write". The one full-suite run used the coverage job's command (.github/workflows/test.yml:39-48) on a git-archive copy of HEAD under Node 26.13.1: exit 0, 49/49 pass, lib/check.mjs at 99.12% lines and 97.78% branches against 85/85. `grep -q '^LF:[1-9]' lcov.info` and `! grep -qx 'LH:0' lcov.info` both exit 0. UAT item 8 (node-test and coverage in CI) is left to CI, as the dispatch directs.

truths.truth: Plan 1: docs/FORMAT.md documents the brief-only mode, What it refuses among the eight sections with each refusal's reason, the [ASSUMPTION] tag as free-text-only contract the check doesn't enforce, and the quote format. Both checks require a non-empty What it refuses between Scope and Vision, and the samples conform.
truths.evidence: docs/FORMAT.md:28-37 lists the eight sections with What it refuses seventh. :41-56 covers refusals ('- ... because ...', never tagged, and the refuses-nothing quote form). :149-164 covers the tag (exact spelling, inline, free text only, never in ID fields or headings, not enforced by the check, a lone tag reads as empty). :166-196 covers the quote format, including design-folder source lines. :212-224 covers 'The brief alone'. lib/check.mjs:9 adds 'What it refuses' between Scope and Vision, and :28-30 reads a lone tag as empty. Spot-checks: moving What it refuses after Vision printed 'brief.md: sections: out of order, expected Problem, Solution, Who it serves, What's different, Success criteria, Scope, What it refuses, Vision'. A body of only '[ASSUMPTION]' printed 'brief.md: What it refuses: empty section'. `node lib/check.mjs samples` printed 'seldon check: all four documents conform', exit 0. The named tests at tests/check.test.mjs:146-182 passed in the suite run.

truths.evidence: skills/seldon/SKILL.md sections 1-11 (:36-301) carry each step in that order. tests/skill.test.mjs:56 pins every check command in the body to the Bash rule's prefix plus '--brief .planning/seldon' (passed in the suite run). Their scores are the walk run's. A debt-marker scan (TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK|placeholder|not implemented) over every non-.planning file the phase touched (787f923..HEAD) found nothing.
